interface.longDescription:
Four independently installable skills guide Traditional Chinese typography for Taiwan and Hong Kong across web pages, documents, presentations, and read-only reviews. Keep supplied text unchanged and distinguish static checks from actual rendered evidence. This is not an automatic layout engine; native host behavior and some rendering scenarios remain unverified.

四個可獨立安裝的技能，支援臺灣及香港繁體中文的網頁、文件、簡報與唯讀檢視。保留原稿，清楚區分靜態檢查與實際描畫證據。本套件不是自動排版引擎；原生主機行為及部分顯示情境仍有待驗證。
